name: Sanguine Surge
description:
Call upon centuries of concentrated vitae to forcefully mend shattered bones and seal severed flesh mid-combat.  Instantly sets crippled limbs to minimum functioning (35 HP), wipes all hemorrhaging, and floods your vitals with regenerative force.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 500 ml
<color_yellow>Cooldown:</color> 30 seconds

name: Rip Out the Heart
description:
You give them one chance to walk away.  Then your bare hand drives straight through their ribcage and closes around their beating heart.  Leaves a gaping, ruined crater in their chest, and anything left weak enough has its heart ripped clean out into your bloody grasp.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 120 ml
<color_yellow>Requirement:</color> Empty hands.

name: Decapitation
description:
One ferocious bare-handed twist of their neck with ancient vampiric strength.  Massive damage to anything with a head, and anything left weak enough has its head violently torn free and launched spinning across the room in a bloody arc.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml
<color_yellow>Requirement:</color> Empty hands.

name: Body Hurl
description:
Seize an adjacent creature with monstrous vampiric strength and hurl it violently in any direction you choose.  Impact damage decays with distance traveled - hurling a target point-blank into a nearby wall delivers maximum catastrophic trauma, while extended tumbling over open ground dissipates kinetic force into crippling bone fractures.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml

name: Corpse Whirlwind
description:
Seize an adjacent creature and whip its entire body in a furious, bone-breaking 360-degree whirlwind around you, battering all surrounding enemies with crushing blunt force before flinging the mangled corpse away.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Centrifugal Whirlwind Sweep
description: Centrifugal impact of Corpse Whirlwind hitting surrounding enemies.

name: Supersonic Kinetic Throw
description:
Channel monstrous vampiric strength to fling an item chosen from your inventory at supersonic velocity up to 18 tiles away.  The projectile breaks the sound barrier with a thunderous crack, piercing through the target like a high-caliber round.  Kinetic damage decays with flight distance beyond close range as atmospheric resistance slows the supersonic projectile.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
<color_yellow>Eligible Projectiles:</color> Coins, loose ammunition, pebbles, nails, spikes, ball bearings, glass bottles/shards, bones, severed heads/arms/legs, pens, cutlery, sports balls (bowling/pool/baseball), wooden stakes, rebar, tools, and blades.

name: Preternatural Fledgling Throw
description:
Fling a small weapon, stone, coin, or improvised projectile from your inventory with preternatural vampire velocity up to 7 tiles away. Marginally faster and sharper than a mortal throw, impact damage naturally decays over distance.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 5 ml

name: Vampiric Dread Pulse
description: Radiates an overwhelming aura of supernatural terror and slaughter across an 8-tile radius, breaking the morale of living and sentient onlookers.

name: Predatory Blitz & Neck Snap
description:
Moving with ancient vampiric velocity, you blur across the ground directly to your target (up to 10 tiles away), seize their head and jaw, and snap their cervical spine clean off with a sickening CRACK!

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
<color_cyan>Cooldown:</color> 3 seconds

name: Stealth Dread Pulse
description: Terrifies close-range onlookers within 3 tiles of a surgical assassination.

name: Vampire Blood Sharing & Siring
description:
Bite open your wrist and offer your ancient vampire blood to an adjacent human, survivor in transition, or sired Vampire Thrall:
• <color_light_green>Mortal NPC:</color> Bestows 20 seconds of rapid cellular regeneration (knitting broken bones and closing wounds) and imbues them with Vampire Blood in System (24h). If they die within 24 hours (whether by your Neck Snap, weapon, or option [k]), they awaken <color_yellow>In Transition</color>.
• <color_yellow>NPC In Transition:</color> Feed them human blood to complete their transformation into an immortal, regenerating Vampire Thrall.
• <color_cyan>Vampire Thrall:</color> Bestow a forged Lapis Daylight Ring onto them so they never burn in the sun.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml (Refunded when bestowing a Daylight Ring or feeding bottled blood)

name: Predatory Heartbeat & Blood Radar
description:
Tune out the dead world and focus your ancient predatory senses on the rhythmic thumping of beating hearts and the warm copper scent of blood.  Reveals all living and undead creatures within 35 tiles through solid walls and pitch darkness for 15 minutes (or toggles off if already active) and reports every human pulse nearby.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml

name: Vampiric Limb Tear & Spine-Breaker
description:
Seize an adjacent heavily injured, stunned, or downed enemy and choose which limb to savagely rip apart with bare hands: tear off their right arm, left arm, right leg, or left leg, or shatter their lower spine to leave them permanently crippled and crawling on the floor.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 25 ml
<color_yellow>Requirement:</color> Target must be injured, stunned, terrified, or knocked down.

name: Supernatural Breach Kick
description:
Drive your boot forward with 110 points of supernatural vampiric force—shattering doors, walls, obstacles, or vehicle parts in a single thunderous kick, and launching any creature standing on that tile flying backward!

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Supernatural Breach Kick Sound & Terror
description: Caster sound, message, and terror effect of Supernatural Breach Kick.

name: Supernatural Breach Kick Creature Knockback
description: Knockback and shockwave for creatures struck by Supernatural Breach Kick.

name: Forge Lapis Daylight Ring (Occult Ritual)
description:
Perform an ancient, mana-draining occult ritual to bind a permanent solar ward into a blood-tempered ring or normal metal ring from your inventory.  Consumes 1,200 Mana and 300 mL of your blood (or 0 extra blood if using a crafted blood-tempered ring) to create a Lapis Daylight Ring that shields you or a sired Vampire Thrall from the sun.

<color_cyan>Mana Cost:</color> 1,200 Mana
<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 300 mL (raw ring) / 0 mL (blood-tempered ring)
<color_yellow>Component:</color> Any signet, silver, gold, copper, platinum, diamond, or blood-tempered ring.

name: Desiccating Ashen Thrust
description: Drive the Silver Dagger of Desiccation into an adjacent foe, injecting paralyzing white oak ash and dark silver venom.

name: Papa Tunde's Sacrificial Siphon
description: Carve into an adjacent target with Papa Tunde's sacrificial bone blade, siphoning their vital agony directly into your occult mana, vitae, and physical strength.

name: Drink Vervain Tea
description: Ingest steeped vervain tea to fortify mortal blood or burn undead vampires.

name: Expel Wood Splinters
description: Focus your undead anatomy to examine and purge foreign wooden splinters lodged in your flesh.  Opens an action menu allowing you to manually pluck fragments, surge pressurized vitae to blow them out, or cauterize the wound.

name: Supernatural Blur (70 km/h)
description:
Engage continuous supernatural velocity (~70 km/h) by burning 10 mL blood every 10 turns. Slashes movement costs to ~5 moves per tile and grants near-flawless dodge against all incoming attacks. Cast again to toggle off.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 mL upfront, then 10 mL / 10 turns
<color_light_green>Speed:</color> ~70 km/h (-85% move cost)
<color_light_blue>Defense:</color> Flawless Dodge (+50 dodge mod, +30 dodge skill)
